text: Binary: 1 if at least one other-user (non-OP) counter-argument comment in OC_comments (JSON list; order irrelevant) cites a specific, real, named or concretely identified institution, law, policy, program or system in a particular jurisdiction/organization, presented as actually functioning in practice, as support for that comment's counter-argument; quoted others' material counts only if the commenter uses it as support. Does not qualify: abstract principles, hypothetical/invented systems, personal anecdotes without an institution, or failed/non-functioning precedents cited as support. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting the outcome; generic discussion of delta/platform rules stays eligible. Output 0 if the list is valid but no comment qualifies (including empty list); null if OC_comments is missing or malformed.
